wire: payment client -> retry.with_retries -> the payment provider

criteria.text: with_retries(fn, 3) calls fn at most 3 times and returns the first successful result
when all 3 attempts raise, with_retries re-raises the LAST exception, not the first
with_retries itself makes no network, clock, filesystem or randomness call, so it behaves in production exactly as it does in a test
